description: Image Description: The image shows a single orange placed against a dark background. The orange is round with a textured, bright orange peel. At the top, there is a small, dried stem remnant. The surface of the orange appears slightly dimpled, which is typical of citrus fruits. There are some minor blemishes and a visible line indicating a small crack on the peel. The lighting highlights the natural color and texture of the orange, making it stand out against the dark background.
